title: SLEEP is weirder than you think 😴 | part 13
description: You forget most of your dreams in ten minutes. Part 14 tomorrow.
hook: Sleep is weirder than you think.
facts: You forget most of your dreams within ten minutes of waking up.
Some people dream only in black and white.
The record for staying awake is about eleven days.
That falling feeling when you doze off? It's called a hypnic jerk.
Giraffes sleep only a couple of hours a day.
outro: Follow for part fourteen. Sweet dreams. Maybe.
